random_tasks: Coverage bounty: find the single most-used module with zero direct unit tests
Flake hunt: look for fixed waitForTimeout sleeps or order-dependent tests leaking global state
Tier check: find one test exercising the wrong tier (e.g. unit test doing what a visual test should, or vice versa)
Stale test audit: find assertions testing removed, renamed, or dead behavior
Mock audit: find any test mocking real logic it should be exercising — hidden coverage gaps behind fake implementations
Error path check: pick one module and verify its error and edge-case paths are tested, not just the happy path
Dead test hunt: find any test file, describe block, or it() that is skipped, orphaned, or never actually runs in the pipeline
